purpose.fil: Magsanay ng malinaw at magalang na paliwanag ng polisiya.

group_size.en: Pairs or groups of 3–5; observe individuals.
group_size.fil: Magkapareha o pangkat na 3–5; obserbahan ang bawat isa.

materials.en: Published policy lesson and verified local guidance
materials.fil: Nailathalang aralin at natiyak na lokal na gabay

steps.en: Choose a card: a company offers promotional samples; a mother needs breastfeeding space; snacks arrive with disposable cups. Resolve the conflicting AO number in the source before using it.
steps.fil: Pumili: may alok na promotional samples; kailangan ng ina ng lugar sa pagpapasuso; may disposable cups sa meryenda. Tiyakin muna ang magkasalungat na numero ng AO sa source.

steps.en: Assign visitor/resident, BHW and observer. Explain the policy, respond respectfully and identify what requires supervisor confirmation. Rotate and repeat after one specific feedback point.
steps.fil: Italaga ang bisita/residente, BHW at tagamasid. Ipaliwanag ang polisiya, magalang na tumugon at tukuyin ang dapat kumpirmahin sa supervisor. Magpalit at ulitin matapos ang tiyak na puna.

debrief.en: Which words made the explanation clear and respectful?
debrief.fil: Aling pananalita ang malinaw at magalang?

observe.en: Identifies the relevant policy and explains an appropriate response without inventing exceptions.
observe.fil: Natutukoy ang polisiya at angkop na tugon nang walang inimbentong eksepsiyon.

output.en: Observed explanation for the selected situation.

alternative.en: Use one situation in 10 minutes; revisit the others later.
alternative.fil: Isang sitwasyon sa 10 minuto; balikan ang iba.

worksheet.fil: Sitwasyon / polisiya / tugon / tanong sa supervisor
